title: A's power
textContentHtml:
1. He can see and experience the world that the character is from. The only catch is he first have to defeat that character in any kind of duel, be it chess, quiz or even a fight to the death. 

2. There can be another condition like touching the person's head or something. It should be interesting as he will be able to see a person's memory sometimes later on much after their duel. He will get to know about his power slowly.

3. When his power awakens then he can also show others the memories of the world that he already posses. 

4. This is the power that the original supreme A passed on to him with the starting memory of his own life after which he awaks in the classroom!

5. But the key power of A was his imaginations which helps him to imagine various scenarios in real time and tried to find and execute the best of those scenarios!!!!!!
